Scottie Pippen

Scottie Maurice Pippen

(Formerly known as Scotty Maurice Pippen)

(Pip, Scott, Batman, Robin)

Position: Small Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-8, 210lb (203cm, 95kg)

Born: September 25, 1965 in Hamburg, Arkansas us

Relatives: Nephew Kavion Pippen; Son Scotty Pippen Jr.

College: University of Central Arkansas

High School: Hamburg in Hamburg, Arkansas

Draft: Seattle SuperSonics, 1st round (5th pick, 5th overall), 1987 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 7, 1987

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2010 (Full List)

Career Length: 17 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Scottie Pippen?

Scottie Pippen is 60 years old.

Where was Scottie Pippen born?

Scottie Pippen was born in Hamburg, Arkansas.

When was Scottie Pippen born?

Scottie Pippen was born on September 25, 1965.

How tall is Scottie Pippen?

Scottie Pippen is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much did Scottie Pippen weigh when playing?

Scottie Pippen weighed 210 lbs (95 kg) when playing.

Is Scottie Pippen in the Hall of Fame?

Scottie Pippen was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2010 (Full List) .

When was Scottie Pippen drafted?

Scottie Pippen was drafted by Seattle SuperSonics, 1st round (5th pick, 5th overall), 1987 NBA Draft.

What position did Scottie Pippen play?

Small Forward.

When did Scottie Pippen retire?

Scottie Pippen last played in 2004.

What is Scottie Pippen's net worth?

Scottie Pippen made at least $109,957,430 playing professional basketball.

How much did Scottie Pippen make?

Scottie Pippen made $19,727,524 in 2003.

What did Scottie Pippen average?

Scottie Pippen averaged 16.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, and 5.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Scottie Pippen have?

Scottie Pippen won 6 championships.

What schools did Scottie Pippen attend?

Scottie Pippen attended Hamburg in Hamburg, Arkansas and University of Central Arkansas.

What are Scottie Pippen's nicknames?

Pip, Scott, Batman, Robin are nicknames for Scottie Pippen.
